name: largefiletransfer-mcp

tools.name: send_files
tools.description: Upload files or folders from this computer to the user's LargeFileTransfer account and get back a share link anyone can use to download them. Folders are sent whole with their structure; hidden files inside them are skipped. Returns the link when the upload finishes. An upload still running after about 45 seconds keeps going in the background: the link comes back right away and works once the upload completes, and upload_status reports its progress. If this computer isn't connected to LargeFileTransfer yet, nothing is uploaded and the result says how the user approves the connection; call send_files again after they have.

paths.description: Files and/or folders to send. Absolute paths are safest; ~ is expanded. Folders are sent whole.

title.description: Title the recipient sees. Defaults to the file's name, or "<n> files"; set one when sending a folder.

message.description: Optional note shown with the files on the download page.

expiresInDays.description: Days until the link expires. Omit for the account's default; longer than the plan allows is shortened to its maximum.

tools.name: upload_status
tools.description: Check an upload send_files started in this session: progress while it runs, the share link once it completes, or why it failed.

tools.name: list_transfers
tools.description: List the user's most recent sent transfers on LargeFileTransfer, newest first: title, share link, size, file count, when each was created and when it expires. Uploads still in progress appear once complete.

limit.description: How many to list, newest first (1-50, default 10).

instructions: Sends files from this computer through the user's LargeFileTransfer account and returns download links. The first call asks the user to approve this computer in their browser: relay the link and code from the result, wait until they say they have approved it, then call the tool again.
